subject: Invoice VEN036-0022 - input tax credit discrepancy
body:
Dear Royal Tech Ltd team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found a discrepancy for invoice VEN036-0022 dated 9 Sep 2025.

The Supplier's GSTR-2B line shows Rs 4,605 tax while the invoice shows Rs 5,200. Only the lower amount is safe to claim.

Rs 596 of input tax credit depends on this. Please amend your return or correct the booking and confirm once done.

Regards,
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
